/*selectNgResultList*/ SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(A.BTOA_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS BTOA_DATE, MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(A.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE, MAX(A.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME, 'KRKORE0001' AS AGENT, MAX(A.BTOA_USER_NAME) AS BTOA_USER_NAME, MAX(A.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_ID, MAX(DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'GR','결재반려',DECODE(NVL(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE,0),0,'합의대상','Nego합의대상'))) AS SOURCING_STATUS, MAX(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(A.BTOA_END_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') || ' ' || MAX(SUBSTR(NVL(A.BTOA_END_DATE,'19'),0,2)) || '시' AS BTOA_END_DATE, MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, MAX(NVL(A.ITEM_QTY,0)) AS ITEM_QTY, MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = A.ORIGIN_NAME)) AS ORIGIN_NAME, MAX(NVL(A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE,0)) AS BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, MAX(NVL(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0)) AS ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = A.BTOA_USER_DEPT)) AS BTOA_USER_DEPT, MAX(TRIM(A.ATOB_REMARK)) AS ATOB_REMARK, MAX(TRIM(A.IMAGE_KEY)) AS IMAGE_KEY, A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.KEP_USER_ID)) AS KEP_USER_NAME, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE='KRKORE0001')) AS AGENT_NAME,
MAX(A.REG_ITEM_NO) AS REG_ITEM_NO,
MAX(A.CONTRACT_NO) AS CONTRACT_NO, MAX(A.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS CONTRACT_SEQ,
MAX((SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R'))) AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, MAX(NVL(TRIM(A.BTOA_REMARK),'')) AS BTOA_REMARK FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{KEY_2} AND A.GW_GA_NO = #{DOCU_NO} AND A.SO_CA_FLAG='SO' AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R','O') GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION
